**DonorDock offers a single pricing plan called DonorDock ONE at a flat rate of $500 per month.** This includes unlimited contacts, no contracts, no hidden fees, and features like unlimited donor records, gift tracking, custom donation pages, reporting, integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, Eventbrite), volunteer/event tracking, and a 1% flat platform fee on online donations.[1][2][3][4]

Key details:
- **Subscription structure**: Annual subscription with transparent pricing; premium onboarding ($3,800 value) currently included as a limited-time offer.[1][2]
- **Free trial**: Available to test the platform before committing.[2][3][4]
- **Online giving fees**: 5% + $0.30 per transaction platform fee (donor-funded by default; organization pays only Stripe processing fees ~2.9% + $0.30 if donor declines).[5][6]
- **No usage limits**: Unlimited across contacts, gifts, pages, and team communications.[2][7]
- **Comparisons**: Cheaper than alternatives like Network for Good ($300+/month + 3% fee, contact limits, contracts).[7]

Pricing data is from official and review sites, last updated March 2026; contact DonorDock for custom quotes or current negotiations.[2][4]
